subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be completed by documenting current pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current main already delegates Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline insertion to pi-tui, but a configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter bridge would add public TUI config or CLI surface under the repository's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI keybinding bridge with default-compatible behavior, focused tests, and docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui newline insertion as sufficient and intentionally decline the remaining docs/help/config follow-up.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest TUI ownership trail and already provided the prior scope split for this issue.
